activity_summary: At St Helen's Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice. He said the fast was ten days off, and that Ash Wednesday was the fifth of March. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not speak. You came out with the house for dinner.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted ten days with the sermon and did not call across to the Mayor's pew.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Turned the sand-glass twice and sent the parish to dinner with the number ten.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Waited the second glass and kept Alse from treating the sermon as a wait for the loaf.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the short loaf and Sir John's unturned head, and remembered ten.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three rows ahead in the carved pew and did not speak.

facets.activity: Heard Master Thwaite say the fast was ten days off

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A penny, and short by a finger.
